capabilities: Generate character sheet notes from a ribbon button
Select the type of character sheet to create
Fill in and edit pre-built character fields
Store generated sheets in a Characters folder
extras: Tested on Windows and Linux only; the README explicitly asks users not to expect mobile support.
motivation: The author and a friend wanted a full-featured writing app and added character sheets, a core feature they hoped for, on top of Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create structured character sheets for fiction or tabletop characters.
summary: Character sheet generator that creates pre-filled character note templates for fiction writing and roleplay in a Characters folder.
